item.title: reports: total per account and currency
item.brief: In the reports repository (Python), change the CSV totaller to read both the new 4-column CSV (header `date,account,amount_cents,currency`) and legacy 3-column CSV (header `date,account,amount_cents`, treated as USD). Output header `account,currency,total_cents`, one row per (account, currency), sorted by account then currency. A malformed currency code (not exactly three uppercase ASCII letters) prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Add unittest tests covering: legacy input, mixed-currency totals, sort order, malformed currency exits 2. Keep `python3 -m unittest` passing. Update the README. Commit the change in the reports repository with a clear message, using the configured git identity only.

item.title: ledger: add currency column
item.brief:
In the ledger repository (Rust), change the TSV-to-CSV converter to support the optional fourth currency column per the shared contract. Default missing currency to USD. Validate currency codes (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters); on a malformed code print an error naming the 1-based line number to stderr and exit with status 2; other input errors keep status 1. Output header becomes `date,account,amount_cents,currency`. Add unit/integration tests covering: 3-column input defaults to USD, 4-column input, malformed code (lowercase, wrong length, digits) exits 2 with line number, existing error paths still exit 1. Keep `cargo test` passing. Update the README. Commit the change in the ledger repository with a clear message, using the configured git identity only.

pr.body:
Approach: parse_line returns ParseError, which is either Malformed (exit 1) or BadCurrency (exit 2). Entry gains a currency field, defaulted to USD when the fourth TSV column is absent. is_currency_code requires exactly three ASCII uppercase bytes; an empty fourth column is rejected. Currency is validated last, after date, account and amount.

Key files: src/lib.rs (parse_line, is_currency_code, to_csv_row, CSV_HEADER), src/main.rs (exit code mapping, line numbers counted over all raw input lines), tests/ledger.rs (unit tests), tests/cli.rs (new; runs the binary and checks exit codes, stderr line prefix and stdout), README.md.

Checks: cargo test passes (7 unit tests in tests/ledger.rs, 4 CLI tests in tests/cli.rs). clippy clean. fmt: only pre-existing hunks remain.

Review: reviewer agt_01M7WEZQ1XADGHJEMEYG2MQNPH passed the whole change with no blocking findings. Non-blocking follow-ups: currency is not trimmed (a space-padded code exits 2); no version bump or changelog for the breaking output change; the exit-1 test does not cover line numbering past leading blank or comment lines.

Assumptions: the 4th column is strict (no trimming), per the 'exactly three uppercase ASCII letters' wording. Output written before an error is not rolled back, as before.

Follow-ups from review (non-blocking): bump the crate version because the library API changed (parse_line error type, Entry.currency); define and test error precedence when both amount and currency are bad (currently amount, so exit 1); decide whether currency should be trimmed like other fields (currently a trailing space exits 2); separate fmt commit for the pre-existing drift in src/lib.rs.
